topics.title: Keep project replacement timestamps at or after wall clock

entries.title: Keep project replacement timestamps at or after wall clock
entries.rationale: Accepted as an addressable-event consistency fix. Preserve relay authority, monotonic replacement behavior, overflow safety, and compatibility with existing project heads.

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after focused project timestamp tests, relay conflict/clock review, dependency screening, compatibility checks, and CLI gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, timestamp reducer and overflow tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
